message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Test

on:
    push:
        branches:
            - master
    pull_request:
        branches:
            - master

jobs:
    build:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 5

        strategy:
            matrix:
                include:
                    - node-version: 22.x
                      target: chrome
                      type: integration
                    - node-version: 22.x
                      target: chromium
                      type: memory
                    - node-version: 22.x
                      target: node
                      type: integration
                node-version: [22.x]
                target: [firefox]
                type: [unit]
            max-parallel: 3

        steps:
            - name: Checkout repository
              uses: actions/checkout@v7

            - name: Install Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
              uses: actions/setup-node@v7
              with:
                  node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}

            - name: Update npm
              run: |
                  npm install --global npm@12
                  npm --version

            - name: Cache node modules
              uses: actions/cache@v6
              with:
                  path: ~/.npm
                  key: ${{ runner.os }}-node-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
                  restore-keys: |
                      ${{ runner.os }}-node-

            - name: Install dependencies
              run: npm ci

            - name: Install Chrome
              run: npx puppeteer browsers install chrome

            - env:
                  TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
                  TYPE: ${{ matrix.type }}
              name: Run ${{ matrix.type }} tests
              run: |
                  export CHROME_DEVEL_SANDBOX=/opt/google/chrome/chrome-sandbox
                  sudo chown root /opt/google/chrome/chrome-sandbox
                  sudo chmod 4755 /opt/google/chrome/chrome-sandbox
                  npm test",
  "rationale": "The P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT pattern is supported by measured evidence (experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508) showing 26.8% elapsed savings with all successes preserved when a job timeout is added. The repository has representative successful-duration history from CI runs, satisfying the pattern precondition. Adding timeout-minutes: 5 to the build job bounds runaway consumption without altering any test step, matrix coverage, dependency installation, or checkout behavior. No permissions are weakened, no secrets or privileged actions are added, and no new network access is introduced.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508"]
}
